input.geometry: planar local-anisotropic layers normal to z

microbenchmark.scope: resident CUDA-event batches outside full-workflow time and memory window

reference_design.interpretation: Global optimum of the worst material energy bound under the exact stated ordering; not a guarantee of minimum PCG iterations or runtime.
reference_design.floating_point_verification: Float64 tolerance tests, not interval-arithmetic certificates.
reference_design.hg_argument: scale(C)=trace(W*C), W=(t*t.T+7*diag(1,1,1,2,2,2))/60 positive definite; material Loewner bounds therefore also bound stabilization scale ratios.

protocol: 128^3 periodic layered cell; six engineering unit strains; FP64 physics and FP32 FFT; true residual <=1e-8; complete six-load warmup; fresh process; identical material, hybrid storage, reference and GPU execution within each pair; complete-call time includes material construction, operator preparation, load, solve, certification and stress; resident Ku CUDA-event median of five batches of twenty applications, outside workflow window.
